scenarios.title: A persist creature that dies without a -1/-1 counter returns with one
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Safehold Elite, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Shock resolves and Safehold Elite dies.
The persist trigger goes on the stack and resolves.

variants.label: no_counter
variants.expected: Safehold Elite goes to B's graveyard and the persist trigger fires. It returns to the battlefield under B's control with a -1/-1 counter, as a 1/1.

variants.label: has_counter
variants.delta: Safehold Elite starts with a -1/-1 counter (it is a 1/1).
variants.expected: Safehold Elite dies and goes to B's graveyard. Persist does not trigger and it stays in the graveyard.
